final_claim.narrative: A time-respecting route from 303 to 1293 does not exist in the interval when requiring successive hops to occur within 600 time units (step_01). To rule out that the negative result is only due to the 600-unit constraint, I checked reachability with no maximum wait and still found no route (step_02). Together these temporal tests support the conclusion that a genuine time-respecting cascade from 303 to 1293 is absent in [28296, 66695].
